editorial.name: Trullion
editorial.descriptionZh: Trullion 是给会计与审计团队用的 AI 平台，把租赁会计、收入漏损、财报校验、单据匹配、数据提取这些流程自动化，主打可审计——每一步都留可追溯的痕迹。
editorial.takeawayZh: 深绿单色加衬线大字的财务科技首屏
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是整片深墨绿色，顶部细线导航 Auditable AI / Platform / Solutions / Resources 加 Log in 与白底 Book a demo，中央小字 AI Accounting Software 与衬线大标题 Auditable AI Built for Accounting，下面一句 Trullion is the AI-powered accounting platform that automates financial workflows for accounting and audit teams. 和两枚按钮 Book a demo、Why Auditable AI。背景隐约透出一张巨型会计表格水印。往下 The AI Platform for the Next Generation of Accounting 分四块：Trulli（Always-on agentic assistant，Trulli is your newest staff member surfacing answers, spotting patterns…）、Workflows（For Corporate Accounting / For Audit）、Knowledge（Grounded in data）、Financial Integrity（Trust, built in）；Why Teams Choose Trullion 一段写 In an era of generic AI tools and disconnected point solutions，再往下 Built by Industry Leaders 写 Trullion is built by former Big Four and top-firm CPAs。
editorial.pricing: unknown（全站只有 Book a demo 与 Log in，未出现价格或档位）

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Trullion 自己的产品分层、方法论叙事与客户证言（唯一转化动作是 Book a demo），没有可下载的组件或模板，用户拿走的是这一页的视觉与论证顺序；来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com。
jsonLdTypes 里的 WebPage / ImageObject / Organization / WebSite 只是站点自报类型，配合导航的 products / who-we-serve 分区，判定为产品官网而非规范或素材库。

pages.title: Accounting AI Software Solutions | Trullion
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

facts.evidence: 首屏 h1，上方小字写 AI Accounting Software，下方说明 Trullion is the AI-powered accounting platform that automates financial workflows for accounting and audit teams.

facts.value: Trulli — Always-on agentic assistant，正文写 Trulli is your newest staff member surfacing answers, spotting patterns, and making sense of your data in seconds.
facts.evidence: 平台四块之一，对应 /products/ai-agent-trulli 路径。

facts.value: Audit Prep、Lease Accounting、Revenue Leakage、Financial Statement Validation、Document Matching、Data Extraction、Substantive Testing
facts.evidence: 导航 Auditable AI 与 Solutions 两栏展开的功能名，另有 /products/leases、/products/revenue-leakage 等一一对应的页面。

facts.value: Trullion is built by former Big Four and top-firm CPAs who've lived the late nights
facts.evidence: Built by Industry Leaders, for the Future of the Industry 一段。

facts.value: 先按团队分 For Corporate Accounting / For Audit，再按角色分审计团队、内审、财务与会计团队、managed services
